subject: Scope of IP recourse & evidence lane — MSA/Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Tom Graves <tom.graves@aureliasys.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@aureliasys.com, marta.lopez@aureliasys.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aurelia MSA redlines — third-party IP and evidence request

Naomi / Redwood team,

Attached is Aurelia's consolidated redline to the MSA and Order Form. High-level concerns: they want vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims stemming from model outputs, but want to limit our liability to direct outputs and exclude downstream reseller/sub-license claims. They also propose a relatively low cap and a long notice window.

Their legal team has asked for an evidence checklist before they commit to final language: provenance of training data, model card, takedown SLA, and insurance certificates (cyber/tech E&O). See attachment: Aurelia_MSA_redline.pdf.

Can we respond with a narrow, operation-friendly counteroffer that preserves our defend/control position while giving them the evidence they asked for?

Thanks,
Tom
--
Tom Graves
Head of Procurement, Aurelia Systems
Tom.Graves@aureliasys.com
Attachment: Aurelia_MSA_redline.pdf (pdf, 132KB)

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Tom Graves <tom.graves@aureliasys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, legal@aureliasys.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurelia MSA redlines — third-party IP and evidence request

Tom — thanks for the redline. We're broadly aligned on wanting a narrow, operationally-implementable settlement. Proposed approach from my side:

- Scope: Redwood will defend and indemnify for third-party claims that allege direct infringement by Model Output (not claims about Aurelia's use, downstream sublicenses, or general allegations about customer data).
- Definition: "Model Output" limited to content produced by the model at inference that is a verbatim or functionally identical reproduction of a third-party work.
- Conditions: Customer must provide prompt notice, the available evidence listed in the attached EvidenceChecklist.xlsx, and allow Redwood reasonable control of defense (with carve-outs for material conflicts).
- Cap: propose linking the cap to the Order Form (12 months of ARR) instead of an open unlimited warranty.

I'll loop in Legal to confirm precise wording. Operations can prepare the evidence bundle template (model card, training provenance summary, takedown SLA specimen). Next steps: Ben, can you coordinate a short call with Aurelia procurement this week to walk through the evidence list and confirm timeline?

Attaching our draft countertrack: RDW-counterproposal.docx.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Attachment: RDW-counterproposal.docx (docx, 54KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: legal view on narrowed recourse and evidence lane

Naomi / Ben — quick legal note on the proposed compromise:

1) Defense control: we should retain the right to control defense for covered claims but agree to a joint-defense option if Aurelia demonstrates a material business need. Maintain the ability to appoint counsel.
2) Definition precision: change "functionally identical" to "substantially identical" + include an explicit exclusion for outputs produced from Customer-provided proprietary inputs (i.e., if Customer supplies a copyrighted text and output reproduces that text, responsibility remains with Customer).
3) Evidence: attach a short checklist that Ops can fill (Model card, training-data provenance summary, inference logs for sample output, takedown contact, insurance declarations). See attached EvidenceChecklist.xlsx.
4) Insurance & offset: request Aurelia provide certificate of insurance showing E&O/Tech coverage and retain right to offset recoveries by insurance proceeds.

If we accept cap = 12 months ARR, we should get a commercial concession in the Order Form (e.g., extended renewal guarantees or minimum usage commitment) — flag this with Ben for negotiation.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park, Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: EvidenceChecklist.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)

Naomi / team — appreciate the quick, practical counter. Aurelia Legal is open in principle to the narrowed "Model Output" carveout and the evidence lane you propose, subject to final wording. A couple of asks before we advance to DocuSign/procurement:

- Can Redwood confirm a specimen takedown SLA and who on your side would be the operational takedown contact?
- Procurement asks that the cap be clarified in the Order Form (we need exact numeric phrasing) and that the evidence bundle be provided within 10 business days of notice.

If you can share the proposed Order Form clause and the takedown specimen today, we'll route to our procurement and legal for final redline. I'll also ask our procurement lead to open a DocuSign envelope once wording is agreed.

Tom
